title: Love this app
content: If you spend the extra money on the premium this app is good. Although if you prefer unreleased I’d turn elsewhere

title: Too many ads😔
content:
The songs are chefs kiss, the videos are top tier, but the shear amount of ads makes it plummet out of the top ten. U see, it used to be like 
1 ad = 30 minutes of no ads now it’s more like 4 ads = 3 more minutes of more ads. And don’t even...

title: Good and Bad
content:
I get ads but when it freezes the app, causes the episode to restart, it is frustrating to use. 
Ad volume was 25% higher, seems to have been recently fixed.
